payload.text: ISSUE:0008 (high), filed by vc on 2026-11-16 at 2e79f55 on hv's word in vc's window: "Please diagnose, then fix." The fault: hello was seated on 2026-11-15 at 19:19Z by hv's own hand, and the fleet restarted on 2026-11-16 from zsh shells alive since 2026-11-12 that still export CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR, so 24 of 29 sessions are pinned to hello's own store and 1 to engineering01's. doctor's remedy for two logins (ccusage login hello) then loops, engineering01's own store holds a login as hello made by a /login inside the session pinned to it (12:41:47Z), which doctor calls OK, and predict's rate drops engineering01's 58 samples (1.3% an hour printed, 2.1% in the history). Two parts. (1) The live repair, hv's hands and vc's checks from metadata, which is ST0003/WP06's rollout from where rhadamanth stands: clear the pin from every shell that starts Claude, restart the pinned sessions, ccusage login hello, ccusage login engineering01, doctor with no FAIL and no pinned session, then the switch which names. Waiting on hv: how the pins are cleared, and when. (2) The code, for the next cut: cc builds the issue's fix outline items 1 to 5 with its two nits (vc's brief of 2026-11-16, one worktree, one Desk slot); items 6 and 7 are interface text and wait on hv's word about ic. vc reads cc's diff and takes its run as the run. Then dc closes ISSUE:0003 and vc closes WP06.
